## Walkthrough Updates Go toolchain from 1.24.0 to 1.25.0 and bumps numerous module dependencies including Kubernetes, Prometheus, gRPC, OpenTelemetry, and various golang.org/x packages to newer versions. No changes to code logic or exported entities. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Go Toolchain and Kubernetes Components**
`go.mod`|Go toolchain bumped to 1.25.0. Kubernetes API groups (k8s.io/api, k8s.io/apimachinery, k8s.io/client-go, k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver, k8s.io/component-base) and related components updated to v0.35.x. OpenShift modules (openshift/api, openshift/client-go, openshift/library-go) updated to newer pseudo-versions.| |**Monitoring and OpenAPI Packages**
`go.mod`|Prometheus operator and client libraries updated. OpenAPI/Swagger packages (go-openapi/*, kubernetes-sigs/controller-runtime) migrated to v0.22.x/v0.25.x series.| |**Protocol Buffers and gRPC**
`go.mod`|gRPC gateway, gRPC/gRPC-prometheus, protobuf, and gRPC genproto packages updated to newer versions. spf13/cobra bumped to v1.10.2.| |**Observability and Utilities**
`go.mod`|OpenTelemetry modules upgraded to v1.42.x. Testing libraries (gomega) and utilities updated. YAML/v2/v3 packages updated. ETCD and structured-merge-diff upgraded to newer patch versions.| |**Standard Library and Golang.org/x Packages**
`go.mod`|Multiple golang.org/x packages (crypto, exp, net, oauth2, sync, sys, term, text, time, tools) upgraded. go-systemd and other system-level utilities updated.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~15 minutes
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests
📝 Coding Plan - [ ] Generate coding plan for human review comments
